place._theme: The OWNER (the Vale family). Peopled, and NOT infrastructure, so the buyer's pool below is disjoint from this one by construction: one requires the keyword the other excludes. Census 2026-10-08 on Defiant: 62 peopled POIs carrying RECenterLocRef + MapMarker, 36 infrastructure and 26 not. ⏳ Which side gets which is a PLACEHOLDER (Eliza's split on the numbers); Jessica's call on the fiction.
place._second: The FIND (the salvager's stash), any POI, as duo_delve05's find.
place._third: The BUYER (Curator Oduya's war room). Peopled AND infrastructure.

prose.name: Salvage: Service Medal on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A salvager stashed a war medal at the <SecondPlace>. If it's engraved, somebody is missing it.

message.title: Service Medal
message.text: The name on the back is worn past reading. The service number under it is not, and the record lists next of kin at the <Place>.

beats._model: PLACEHOLDER: testcase 01's freight crate. A salvager's stash may want something smaller; his eye.
beats._journal_never_shown: The medal has a name on it, Sergeant Vale, and his service record lists family at the <Place>. I should take it to them.
beats._journal_note: This line was beat 1's journal on the choice kind and was NEVER SHOWN: the offer is set in the same instant and the log shows only the newest line (part 13, his play 2026-10-08). offer.journal opens with the same sentence and is what the player reads. Kept here as Jessica wrote it.

beats.objective: Return the medal to the family
beats.journal: I found a sergeant's Colony War medal in a salvager's stash and took it home to his family at the <Place>.

message.title: Returned
message.text: His daughter turns the medal over twice, says nothing for a while, and puts it in her pocket. She pays what she can.

beats.name: Family Memorial
beats._model: PLACEHOLDER, the owner's delivery point: Akila's memorial podium, z 0.00..1.22, STANDS (gen_inspect bounds 2026-10-08). Name is Eliza's placeholder; Jessica's to word.

beats.objective: Sell the medal to the curator
beats.journal: I found a sergeant's Colony War medal in a salvager's stash and sold it to a curator for his war room.

message.title: Sold
message.text: The curator pays in full and packs it away for the war room. The card is already written: the rank, the service number, and the years.

beats.name: Curator's Collection
beats._model: The buyer's delivery point is a footlocker (AK_FootLocker01_Static: z -0.00..0.28, 1.0 x 0.4 m, STANDS). His playtest 2026-10-08: "The display cabinent looks wierd in the middle of a POI. Prob be a chest." The tilted display case it replaced is shop furniture, which reads wrong standing alone on open ground. Name is Eliza's placeholder; Jessica's to word.

offer.journal: The engraving is worn past reading, but his service record lists family at the <Place>. Word travels fast. A curator wants the medal for his war room and will pay more than the family can. It's my call.
offer._journal: His play 2026-10-08: "the log doesn't read quite right, I think the family delivery one is skipped". The log shows only the NEWEST stage's line, and the driver sets 50 (the family line) and 60 (this one) in the same instant, so 50 is never seen. So this line carries both of Jessica's sentences, verbatim, family first; her "I should take it to them" is dropped as the one clause the choice contradicts. ⏳ Jessica's to reword as one line if she likes.

message.title: Incoming Message
message.text: Heard you turned up a Colony War medal. I keep a small war room back home. People come to see it. I'm at the <ThirdPlace> now. I'll pay more than the family can, and it goes on the wall with his record under it. - The Curator

_company: His play 2026-10-08: "the created NPCs are alone at the POIs which looks wierd. Can we get like a few nameless npcs", and "can we set there outfit in the json, so we can dress them up". ⏳ PLACEHOLDERS, his to dress: Maren in a colonist's padded vest among colonists (Civ_LIST = LvlLISTColonist); Oduya in shirt, slacks and vest among Construx workers (an infrastructure site). Outfits are any vanilla Outfit EditorID (596 in Starfield.esm); company lists are Overtime's duo_GangMembersList_Civ_* (friendly).

Templates are from NPCTools.GetTemplateFriendlyNPC's talkable set. ⏳ "Vale's Daughter" is a PLACEHOLDER: Jessica's prose never names her, so the name is hers to give (checked against his who's-who, no family name). Oduya is her name.
_reward: Overtime's own ladder, on each ending's completing stage (QRCR/QRXP): easy 1,250 cr / 250 xp, med 2,800 / 500, hard 7,500 / 1,500. His first play 2026-10-08 paid 1,250 + 2,500 on the buyer's ending, because the stage reward the base carries was copied to it AND the driver paid on top; the driver pays nothing now. ⏳ PLACEHOLDER TIERS, his to set: the buyer one rung above the owner, which is the design's only rule.
